name: CargoClaimsManager
tagline: File every freight loss and damage claim on time, chase every carrier response and see what you actually recover – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete freight claims desk for shippers, 3PLs and forwarders: documentation checklist per claim type, filing deadline from the delivery date, filing rules and claim letter, carrier acknowledgement, disposition and payment clocks, partial offers with a minimum-offer rule, counters and appeals within the suit window, settlement, payment and short-pay tracking, write-offs, a deadline calendar, pipeline board and recovery KPIs per carrier. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Filing deadline, acknowledgement, disposition, payment and suit-window clocks
Documentation checklist per claim type blocks incomplete filings
Claim and follow-up letters from a template → Power Fx / Outlook
Partial offers, minimum offer %, value approval threshold, counters and appeals
Settlement, payment and short-pay tracking, write-offs
Recovery rate, decline rate and days to settle per carrier
Bulk assign, follow-up letters, close + undo
Keyboard and phone layout with bottom bar
ClaimsCsv and SummaryJson for Teams / email / Power BI flows
Demo mode with fictional sample data
controlType: standard (2 controls: niray_Niray.CargoClaimsManager data-set + niray_Niray.CargoClaimsManagerPortal field control)
